Manson himself was a man of imposing stature, his broad shoulders and scarred hands a testament to a life spent in the shadows. He had a taste for control that bordered on obsession; he loved to watch his power manifest in the most visceral ways.

Her hair was cropped close to her scalp, and her gaze was fierce, a mixture of calculation and unbridled confidence. Priscilla was a dominatrix by profession, but her skills stretched far beyond the confines of any dungeon. She was a martial arts master, with a background that spanned judo, taekwondo, and Brazilian jiu‑jitsu. Her body was honed by years of disciplined training, and she moved with an animalistic grace that made her an almost mythical figure on the streets.

Priscilla’s reputation was well known. Whenever a minion had displeased Manson, it was not enough for him to simply send them to the back of the warehouse and let them suffer a quiet fate.
